subject.title: fix(tts): allow trusted local media in message_tool_only mode

question: Should `message_tool_only` allow internally trusted local media to bypass source suppression as stripped media-only content, or should this PR narrow the bypass to TTS/tool-media-specific provenance?
rationale: The code path appears mechanically sound, but the permanent boundary for private text suppression versus automatic trusted media delivery is a maintainer trust-boundary decision.

options.title: Accept trustedLocalMedia boundary
options.body: Land the current scoped exception with media-present checks, text stripping, sendPolicy denial preserved, and untrusted media still suppressed.

options.title: Require TTS-only provenance
options.body: Ask for a small follow-up patch that keys the bypass to TTS/tool-media provenance instead of all trusted local media.

options.title: Reject suppressed media bypass
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep the canonical issue open for a different explicit message-tool delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Accept trustedLocalMedia boundary
recommendation.body: Land the current scoped exception with media-present checks, text stripping, sendPolicy denial preserved, and untrusted media still suppressed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged recent adjacent TTS delivery work and is the clearest routing candidate for the suppression trust-boundary choice.
